source.elastic_status: gap — no Fleet SAP HANA integration; Prom path via Managed PRW / Agent Prometheus input

ingest.recommended: Deploy SUSE hanadb_exporter → scrape → Elastic Managed Prometheus Remote Write (or Agent prometheus/metrics input)

metrics.name: hanadb_alerts_current
metrics.description: HANA Database current alerts rating

metrics.name: hanadb_column_tables_used_memory
metrics.description: Column tables total memory used in MB

metrics.name: hanadb_connections_total
metrics.description: Number of connections grouped by Type and Status

metrics.name: hanadb_cpu_busy

metrics.description: Percentage of CPU time not spent by HANA DB, over the last minute (in seconds)

metrics.name: hanadb_cpu_system
metrics.description: Percentage of CPU time spent by HANA DB in Kernel space, over the last minute (in seconds)

metrics.description: Percentage of CPU time spent by HANA DB in user space, over the last minute (in seconds)

metrics.name: hanadb_cpu_waitio
metrics.description: Percentage of CPU time spent by HANA DB in IO mode, over the last minute (in seconds)

metrics.name: hanadb_disk_data_files_available_size

metrics.description: Used space per file and file type (in MB)

metrics.name: hanadb_disk_io_latency
metrics.description: Total I/O latency (ms), calculated from the sum of service and wait time

metrics.name: hanadb_disk_io_queue_length
metrics.description: I/O queue length (average queue length of the requests that were issued to the Disk Device)

metrics.name: hanadb_disk_io_requests_per
metrics.description: I/O requests per second

metrics.description: I/O service time in ms

metrics.description: Specifies the used volume size in MB. It will be repeated if the volume is shared between usages_types.

metrics.description: Total physical memory per host in MB

metrics.description: Free swap memory per host in MB

metrics.name: hanadb_host_memory_swap_used
metrics.description: Used swap memory per host in MB

metrics.description: Peak memory from the memory pool used by SAP HANA processes since the instance started (this is a sample-based value) per host in MB

metrics.description: Amount of memory from the memory pool that is currently being used by SAP HANA processes per host in MB

metrics.description: Average elapsed time per execution by service and SQL type in miliseconds

metrics.description: Total elapsed time of SQL statements executions by service and SQL type in miliseconds

metrics.name: hanadb_sql_service_executions
metrics.description: Total number of SQL statements executions by service and SQL type

metrics.description: Average lock wait time per execution by service and SQL type in miliseconds

metrics.name: hanadb_sr_async_used_shipping_buffer
metrics.description: System Replication current filling level of asynchronous log shipping buffer (MB)

metrics.name: hanadb_sr_replication
metrics.description: System Replication status. Values: 0-ACTIVE, 1-INITIALIZING, 2-SYNCING, 3-UNKNOWN, 4-ERROR, 99-UNMAPPED

metrics.name: hanadb_sr_secondary_active
metrics.description: System Replication - Specifies the secondary active status. Values: 0 - INACTIVE and 1 - ACTIVE

metrics.name: hanadb_sr_secondary_failover
metrics.description: System Replication secondary failover count

metrics.name: hanadb_sr_secondary_reconnect
metrics.description: System Replication secondary reconnect count

metrics.name: hanadb_sr_ship_delay
metrics.description: System Replication log shipping delay in seconds

metrics.name: hanadb_sr_takeover_duration_time
metrics.description: System Replication takeover duration time. Returns -1 if cannot be calculated, together with END_TIME=N/A. It is a workaround to when HANA cannot collect this value

metrics.name: hanadb_sr_takeover_log_position
metrics.description: Specifies the master log position, that has been reached by takeover

metrics.name: hanadb_sr_takeover_replication
metrics.description: System Replication status at takeover time. Values: 0-ACTIVE, 1-INITIALIZING, 2-SYNCING, 3-UNKNOWN, 4-ERROR, 99-UNMAPPED

metrics.name: hanadb_sr_takeover_shipped_log_position
metrics.description: Specifies the highest master log position that has been shipped before executing takeover

metrics.name: hanadb_table_cs_top_mem_disk_size
metrics.description: Top 10 tables consuming more memory. The total disk size of all of the table parts

metrics.name: hanadb_table_cs_top_mem_estimated_max
metrics.description: Top 10 tables consuming more memory. The estimated maximum memory consumption (MB), in total, for the fully loaded table (data for open transactions is not included)

metrics.name: hanadb_table_cs_top_mem_record
metrics.description: Top 10 tables consuming more memory. The record count of the table

metrics.name: hanadb_table_cs_top_mem_total
metrics.description: Top 10 tables consuming more memory. The total memory size (MB) is the sum of memory size in the main, delta, and history parts
